note: The published reader codes the generated crate raises at run time, extracted from conformance/diagnostic-codes.json rather than retyped. `cli.mjs check` re-reads that artefact and fails on drift. This table is not a second registry: `diagnostics.mjs` closes the codes the *generator* emits, and the published set closes the codes a *reader* decides. A code the generated crate raises while deciding a value it was handed belongs to the second set, and minting an `agent-ix.rust-backend.*` spelling for a defect the published set already names would be the duplication SR-066 FND-500 records.

UNKNOWN_REQUIRED_EXTENSION.rule: A required extension the consumer policy does not list while it rejects unknown extensions.
